doubts: No supplement; appendix pages are the main PDF's. Q3: the method-specific constants are given, but the base SAC/TD3/PPO training hyperparameters are deferred to the offline phase and CORL without listing, so no. Q6: the choice of τ (and α) is argued from a stated criterion, coded yes. X3: the reference policy is the best checkpoint picked on online evaluations, which the authors admit uses test information; it constrains training rather than selecting the reported number, coded yes with hesitation. X7: Table 5 gives hours per phase on one GPU (checklist answers No on compute). Y3: HalfCheetah, Hopper, Walker2d, AntMaze = 4 (dataset qualities count once). Y6: TD3+BC on harder AntMaze and baselines on AntMaze omitted with stated reasons. Y7: all D4RL datasets carry the -v2 suffix. Y9: alpha varied in Figure 13 (performance during value alignment).
